decisions.reason: Closely related to existing supplement knowledge and with a clear launch message, the firm can interpret and improve the product, making withdrawal unlikely.
As a related dietary supplement with enough existing knowledge, the firm can learn from early results and likely keep improving it.
Although mushroom-based is somewhat novel, it still builds on supplement capabilities, giving the firm moderate absorptive capacity to keep and monitor it.
Distant from the established offer and with no recent website presence, limited related knowledge makes it hard to learn and improve, so withdrawal is likely.
